content.summary: Review of Git Review UI feature (WI-01 through WI-06): PASS with suggestions

findings.issue: Unbounded memory for untracked file line-counting via Bun.file().text()
findings.suggestion: Add a size cap before reading full file content for line counting

findings.issue: Sequential execution of 5 independent git commands in File.status()
File.read() fetches both staged and unstaged diffs regardless of stage parameter
findings.suggestion: Conditionally fetch only the requested diff

findings.issue: Destructuring used for navigate/theme against style guide
findings.suggestion: Use dot notation per project conventions

findings.issue: No test case for lineAnchors with status='added'
findings.suggestion: Add test for added file anchor extraction

code.summary: Functional and well-structured. Performance optimizations available for git command parallelization and conditional diff fetching.

findings.issue: Path containment is lexical-only; symlinks can escape project directory. Pre-existing issue with TODO already documented in upstream code — not introduced by this feature.
findings.suggestion: Future: canonicalize with realpath before boundary check

findings.issue: Full file reads for untracked line counting without size limits
findings.suggestion: Add max file size check before reading

findings.issue: Comment text inserted into prompt without control character sanitization
findings.suggestion: Strip ANSI escape sequences and control characters from comment text

security.summary: No injection vectors found. Git subprocess calls use Bun tagged templates safely. Path traversal concern is pre-existing upstream and documented. Minor output sanitization gap in comment formatting.

findings.issue: UI component synthesizes git diff patches (makeDiff) instead of receiving them from backend
findings.suggestion: Move diff synthesis to File.read() backend to keep UI as pure renderer

findings.issue: Heavy directory-tree transformation logic inside UI component memo
findings.suggestion: Extract to a pure transformer function for testability

simplicity.summary: Well-separated architecture: orchestrator (index.tsx) delegates to focused children, pure logic in format-comments.ts. Minor what/how braid with client-side diff synthesis.

requirements.summary: All acceptance criteria across all 6 work items fully implemented and verified against code. No scope creep. Original user intent preserved.

suggestions: Parallelize 5 sequential git commands in File.status() with Promise.all for latency improvement
Conditionally fetch only staged or unstaged diff in File.read() based on stage param
Move makeDiff() synthetic diff generation from diff-pane.tsx to backend File.read()
Add size cap before Bun.file().text() for untracked file line counting
Strip control characters from comment text before prompt injection
Add lineAnchors test case for status='added'
Extract file-list grouping logic to pure transformer function

trace_report.original_problem: Project-scoped git review UI for staged/unstaged changes with file navigation, diff viewing, and line comments
